items.name: FlightDataEncoder
items.summary: Stream that encodes a stream of record batches to flight data.

methods.name: known_schema
methods.summary: Report the schema of the encoded data when known. A schema is known when provided via the [`FlightDataEncoderBuilder::with_schema`] method.

methods.name: poll_next
methods.signature: fn poll_next(Pin<&mut self>, cx: &mut std::task::Context<'_>) -> Poll<Option<Self::Item>>

items.name: FlightDataEncoderBuilder
items.summary: Creates a [`Stream`] of [`FlightData`]s from a `Stream` of [`Result`]<[`RecordBatch`], [`FlightError`]>.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<S>(self, input: S) -> FlightDataEncoder where S: Stream<Item = Result<RecordBatch>> + Send + 'static
methods.summary: Takes a [`Stream`] of [`Result<RecordBatch>`] and returns a [`Stream`] of [`FlightData`], consuming self.

methods.name: with_flight_descriptor
methods.summary: Specify a flight descriptor in the first FlightData message.

methods.name: with_max_flight_data_size
methods.summary: Set the (approximate) maximum size, in bytes, of the [`FlightData`] produced by this encoder. Defaults to 2MB.

methods.name: with_metadata
methods.summary: Specify application specific metadata included in the [`FlightData::app_metadata`] field of the the first Schema message

methods.name: with_options
methods.summary: Set the [`IpcWriteOptions`] used to encode the [`RecordBatch`]es for transport.

methods.name: with_schema
methods.summary: Specify a schema for the RecordBatches being sent. If a schema is not specified, an encoded Schema message will be sent when the first [`RecordBatch`], if any, is encoded. Some clients expect a Schema message even if there is no data sent.
